adapterDiagnosis.basis: The successful sanitized API capture retained three workflow_end answers and both terminal events. The pre-fix adapter ignored workflow_end and required message text, which supported an initial parser hypothesis. A second authorized Desktop invocation using the rebuilt adapter still failed with the same sanitized response-validation error. Neither Desktop invocation retained the raw response or sanitized event statistics, so the production failure cannot be attributed to terminal ordering or workflow_end selection without more evidence.
adapterDiagnosis.selectionRule: For streams containing workflow_start or workflow_end, keep only the latest completed workflow answer and return it only after task_end followed by end; later failure events override all partial output.
adapterDiagnosis.liveResult: The selection rule passes synthetic fixtures but did not make the second live Desktop task succeed.
